prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1432; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed parking lot collision between two insured vehicles. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side rear quarter panel. Photos requested from insured and scene location noted as a commercial lot with posted cameras. Coverage confirmed under liability and collision.

Entry 2: Claimant's vehicle inspected. Rear bumper and quarter panel damage consistent with reported impact. Estimate requested from preferred repair facility. Claimant has reported lower back strain and has since retained counsel, who has requested all future contact be routed through the firm.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Counsel confirmed representation and asked for copies of the policy declarations page, the incident report, and the adjuster's photographs. Requested medical authorization forms and advised that the file will be sent once the records request is processed.

Entry 4: Received treatment records from the claimant's primary care provider. Diagnosis listed as lumbar strain with recommended physical therapy over several weeks. No prior history of back complaints noted in the submitted records. Requested itemized billing and prior claims history from the claimant's counsel.

Entry 5: Reviewed the file with the supervisor. Liability appears probable for the insured's vehicle based on the statement and the scene camera footage request. Injury claim remains open pending completion of physical therapy and receipt of billing. Reserve reviewed and flagged for reassessment after the next medical update. Counsel to be notified of the status in writing.
